title: Tunnel
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §7 (4.end 'Tunnel': the metro tunnels, the last route; endings TBD, ADR-10), act4 doc §9 / ADR-52 proposed (three endings: Evacuate — side with Karthik and Rathore's convoy, Rathore may betray, Deepa left unless cured, city lost; Hold the hill — stay with Suresh's community, Suresh's sacrifice, no cure, people live; Ground Zero — side with Priya, Pulse Gun + Deepa's data, enter HIVR, needs all five runs, `ravi_supported` changes the final scene), chapter_board_merge §B3 (underground stations = military UV camps; elevated stations' shade = nests), landmarks doc §3.4 (a 'My Bangalore' end card, shareable), ADR-53 (honest trailer: only shipped endings shown).
player_goal: Get your people through the tunnel to where you chose to go.
design_goal: The game's last route goes under the city the player watched being built in Acts 1–2 (the metro opened in 2.2). Dark, generator-lit, infected in the shade between stations. At Majestic the choice the group made at Lalbagh plays out. Each ending costs something; none is 'good'. Then the 'My Bangalore' card: days survived, PGs rejected, ₹ spent on chai.

cast.npc: npc_suresh / npc_karthik / npc_priya / npc_deepa / npc_ananya / npc_kumar
cast.spawn: (the group, by who is alive and with you)
cast.role: Walk with you as companions (the `companion` behaviour).
The convoy at the railway station.

beats.what: Cubbon Park underground station (an army UV camp): down onto the tracks. The Purple Line tunnel west: emergency lights, a stalled train you walk through (the coach from 2.2's first ride, the seat-for-elderly sign), infected in the dark between stations — stealth, noise, the Pulse Gun if you have it.

Majestic interchange (2.4's lost uncle's platform): the group's choice plays. EVACUATE: Rathore's convoy at the railway station — if trust is low he leaves the group behind and takes you only. HOLD: back up and out to Lalbagh; Suresh stays at the gate with the generator so the rest get in. GROUND ZERO: north on foot with Priya to HIVR; the Pulse Gun and Deepa's data; Meera; the source. Ravi's state changes the last scene.

The ending card (one per ending), then 'My Bangalore': a pixel collage of your City Moments + stats (days survived, PGs rejected, ₹ spent on chai, people you met) — shareable (Web Share via the platform layer).

assets_needed: the metro tunnel pocket(s) (dark, emergency lights, a stalled coach — reuse metro_interior)
acceptance: all three endings reachable; each a card; the end card renders and shares
